Each arc rises from the year a prophecy was given and comes back to the spine at the year it was fulfilled, beside its line in the index. Dates on Ken Johnson's chronology (AM = AD + 3925); "c." = approximate.

Sources: Ken Johnson, Ancient Prophecies Revealed (#1–485; numbers in grey) and his chronology; Scripture (KJV); Dead Sea Scroll manuscripts in green italics. Foretold dates are approximate dates of the prophet.
